(2016, 2018) describing the dynamic outcomes arising from the interactions between patients and physicians, whose behavior is subject to clinical and legal risks. In particular, Antoci et al. (2016) analyzed the case of positive defensive medicine, while Antoci et al.

arxiv-2104-08257.title: A new matroid lift construction and an application to group-labeled graphs
arxiv-2104-08257.creator: Zach Walsh
arxiv-2104-08257.description: Abstract . A well-known result of Brylawski constructs an elementary lift of a matroid M M from a linear class of circuits of M M . We generalize this result by showing how to construct a rank- k k lift of M M from a rank- k k matroid on the set of circuits of M M .

arxiv-2201-04992.title: Stem-loop formation drives RNA folding in mechanical unzipping experiments
arxiv-2201-04992.creator: Paolo Rissone, Cristiano V. Bizarro, Felix Ritort
arxiv-2201-04992.description: Abstract Accurate knowledge of RNA hybridization is essential for understanding RNA structure and function. Here we mechanically unzip and rezip a 2kbp RNA hairpin and derive the ten nearest-neighbor base-pair (NNBP) RNA free energies in sodium and magnesium with 0.1 kcal/mol precision using optical tweezers.

arxiv-2205-10391.title: A structural model of genome-wide association studies.
arxiv-2205-10391.creator: Christopher Salahub
arxiv-2205-10391.description: Abstract A structural genetic model incorporating a modern understanding of the genome and common practice in genome-wide association studies is derived mathematically. The model shows the Haldane map distance as a direct consequence of the structure of the genome. An expression for genetic correlation is derived under the model and compared to data resulting from the BSB mouse cross.

arxiv-2212-02121.title: 2 2 -Ruled hypersurfaces in a Walker 4 4 -manifold
arxiv-2212-02121.creator: Mohamed Ayatola Dramé*, Ameth Ndiaye**, Abdoul Salam Diallo***
arxiv-2212-02121.description: Abstract . The hypersurface is one of the most important objects in a space. Many authors studied diffrent geometric aspects of hypersurfaces in a space. In this paper, we define three types of 2 2 -ruled hypersurfaces in a Walker 4 4 -manfold 𝔼 1 4 \mathbb{E}^{4}_{1} .

arxiv-2309-15924.title: DUNE potential as a New Physics probe
arxiv-2309-15924.creator: Adriano Cherchiglia, José Santiago
arxiv-2309-15924.description: Abstract Neutrino experiments, in the next years, aim to determine with precision all the six parameters of the three-neutrino standard paradigm. The complete success of the experimental program is, nevertheless, attached to the non-existence (or at least smallness) of Non-Standard Interactions (NSI).

arxiv-2310-01602.title: CAT-LM Training Language Models on Aligned Code And Tests
arxiv-2310-01602.creator: Nikitha Rao 1 , Kush Jain 1 , Uri Alon, Claire Le Goues, Vincent J. Hellendoorn
arxiv-2310-01602.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Nikitha Rao 1 , Kush Jain 1 , Uri Alon, Claire Le Goues, Vincent J. Hellendoorn. Testing is an integral but often neglected part of the software development process. Classical test generation tools such as EvoSuite generate behavioral test suites by optimizing for coverage, but tend to produce tests that are hard to understand.

arxiv-2407-16685.title: Fractional Holographic Dark Energy
arxiv-2407-16685.creator: Oem Trivedi, Ayush Bidlan, Paulo Moniz
arxiv-2407-16685.description: Abstract Holographic dark energy theories present a fascinating interface to probe late-time cosmology, as guided by contemporary ideas about quantum gravity. In this work, we present a new holographic dark energy scenario designated “Fractional Holographic Dark Energy”(FHDE). This model extends the conventional framework of HDEs by incorporating specific features from fractional calculus recently applied, e.g., in cosmological settings.

arxiv-2411-02630.title: Multipartite entanglement structures in quantum stabilizer states
arxiv-2411-02630.creator: Vaibhav Sharma, Erich J Mueller
arxiv-2411-02630.description: Abstract We develop a method for visualizing the internal structure of multipartite entanglement in pure stabilizer states. Our algorithm graphically organizes the many-body correlations in a hierarchical structure. This provides a rich taxonomy from which one can simultaneously extract many quantitative features of a state including some traditional quantities such as entanglement depth, k k -uniformity and entanglement entropy.

arxiv-2508-20174.title: Compilation-informed probabilistic quantum error cancellation
arxiv-2508-20174.creator: Giancarlo Camilo, Thiago O. Maciel, Allan Tosta, Abdulla Alhajri, Thais de Lima Silva, Daniel Stilck França, Leandro Aolita
arxiv-2508-20174.description: Abstract The potential of quantum computers to outperform classical ones in practically useful tasks remains challenging in the near term due to scaling limitations and high error rates of current quantum hardware. While quantum error correction (QEC) offers a clear path towards fault tolerance, overcoming the scalability issues will take time.

arxiv-2510-05367.title: LightCache: Memory-Efficient, Training-Free Acceleration for Video Generation
arxiv-2510-05367.creator: Yang Xiao, Gen Li, Kaiyuan Deng, Yushu Wu, Zheng Zhan, Yanzhi Wang, Xiaolong Ma, Bo Hui
arxiv-2510-05367.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yang Xiao, Gen Li, Kaiyuan Deng, Yushu Wu, Zheng Zhan, Yanzhi Wang, Xiaolong Ma, Bo Hui. Training-free acceleration has emerged as an advanced research area in video generation based on diffusion models. The redundancy of latents in diffusion model inference provides a natural entry point for acceleration. In this paper, we decompose the inference process into the encoding, denoising, and decoding stages, and observe that cache-based acceleration methods often lead to substantial memory surges in the latter two stages.

arxiv-2602-03572.title: Fluctuations of the inverted magnetic state and how to sense them
arxiv-2602-03572.creator: Anna-Luisa E. Römling 1, Artim L. Bassant 2, Rembert A. Duine 2,3
arxiv-2602-03572.description: Abstract Magnons are the low-energy excitations of magnetically ordered materials. While the magnetic moment of a ferromagnet aligns with an applied magnetic field, it has been experimentally shown that the magnetic order can be inverted by injecting spin current into the magnet.

arxiv-2602-07697.title: On the Infinite Width and Depth Limits of Predictive Coding Networks
arxiv-2602-07697.creator: Francesco Innocenti, El Mehdi Achour, Rafal Bogacz
arxiv-2602-07697.description: Abstract Predictive coding (PC) is a biologically plausible alternative to standard backpropagation (BP) that minimises an energy function with respect to network activities before updating weights. Recent work has improved the training stability of deep PC networks (PCNs) by leveraging some BP-inspired reparameterisations. However, the full scalability and theoretical basis of these approaches remains unclear.

pmc-10559617.title: Proteasome inhibition protects blood–brain barrier P-glycoprotein and lowers Aβ brain levels in an Alzheimer’s disease model
pmc-10559617.creator: Milica Vulin, Yu Zhong, Bryan J. Maloney, Björn Bauer, Anika M. S. Hartz
pmc-10559617.description: BackgroundLoss of P-glycoprotein (P-gp) at the blood–brain barrier contributes to amyloid-β (Aβ) brain accumulation in Alzheimer’s disease (AD). Using transgenic human amyloid precursor protein (hAPP)-overexpressing mice (Tg2576), we previously showed that Aβ triggers P-gp loss by activating the ubiquitin–proteasome pathway, which leads to P-gp degradation.

pmc-11422345.title: An efficient grasping shared control architecture for unpredictable and unspecified tasks
pmc-11422345.creator: Shaowen Cheng, Yongbin Jin, Yanhong Liang, Lei Jiang, Hongtao Wang
pmc-11422345.description: Robot control in complex and unpredictable scenarios presents challenges such as adaptability, robustness, and human-robot interaction. These scenarios often require robots to perform tasks that involve unknown objects in unstructured environments with high levels of uncertainty. Traditional control methods, such as automatic control, may not be suitable due to their limited adaptability and reliance on prior knowledge.

pmc-11577128.title: Effects of cricket powder on structural and mechanical properties of soy protein isolate extrudates
pmc-11577128.creator: Zhaojun Wang, Qian Deng, Yuliang Zhou, Xinyue Qi, Leehow Lau, Yuqiao He, Zhiyong He, Maomao Zeng, Qiuming Chen, Jie Chen, Hui Ye
pmc-11577128.description: This study investigated the impact of cricket powder (CP) incorporation on the structural and mechanical properties of soy protein isolate (SPI) extrudates. The physicochemical properties of CP, rheological properties of SPI-CP blends and their potential structuring properties were evaluated. The results showed that CP had a high protein content (72.10 ± 0.61%) and a notable amount of dietary fiber.

pmc-11578891.title: Structure of the human TIP60-C histone exchange and acetyltransferase complex
pmc-11578891.creator: Changqing Li, Ekaterina Smirnova, Charlotte Schnitzler, Corinne Crucifix, Jean Paul Concordet, Alice Brion, Arnaud Poterszman, Patrick Schultz, Gabor Papai, Adam Ben-Shem
pmc-11578891.description: Chromatin structure is a key regulator of DNA transcription, replication and repair1. In humans, the TIP60–EP400 complex (TIP60-C) is a 20-subunit assembly that affects chromatin structure through two enzymatic activities: ATP-dependent exchange of histone H2A–H2B for H2A.Z–H2B, and histone acetylation. In yeast, however, these activities are performed by two independent complexes—SWR1 and NuA4, respectively2,3.

pmc-11606288.title: Optimizing the incubation conditions of third-stage larvae of the camel nasal bot Cephalopina titillator (Diptera: Oestridae) for harvesting adult flies
pmc-11606288.creator: Mohammad Nafi Solaiman Al-Sabi, Hams Almohammed, Fatema Alghatam, Ghadeer Alhafiz, Omar Al-Jabr, Ahmed M A Meligy
pmc-11606288.description: Background and Aim:Understanding the developmental conditions of Cephalopina titillator larvae and their effect on the success of pupation and adult emergence can help prevent and control this disease in camels. Incubating C. titillator larvae in vitro requires optimized conditions that have not been adequately reported in the literature.

pmc-12599026.title: Pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy followed by maintenance with or without olaparib as first-line treatment for advanced BRCAwt ovarian cancer with LOH-low: a international cost-effectiveness analysis
pmc-12599026.creator: Kun Liu, Xiaofang Zhou, Youwen Zhu, Hong Zhu
pmc-12599026.description: BackgroundPatients with advanced ovarian cancer (AOC) who are BRCA wild-type (BRCAwt) or exhibit low loss of heterozygosity (LOH-low) typically face a poor prognosis and have limited therapeutic options. Pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy followed by maintenance with or without olaparib (PCO or PC) brings new hope to these patients.

pmc-12650947.title: irreversibility: A Python Package for Assessing and Manipulating the Time Irreversibility of Real-World Time Series
pmc-12650947.creator: Massimiliano Zanin
pmc-12650947.description: Time irreversibility refers to the property of some dynamical systems and time series of being statistically different when observed backward in time. While the theoretical foundations of irreversibility date back to the origin of statistical physics, the analysis of such property in real-world time series has only recently gained momentum. We present irreversibility, an open-source Python (version ≥ 3.

pmc-13161587.title: Profiling of tumour board characteristics and functioning for cancer care under hospitals registered under National Cancer Registry Programme in India
pmc-13161587.creator: Gokul Sarveswaran, Jayasankar Sankarapillai, Kondalli Lakshminarayana Sudarshan, Prashant Mathur
pmc-13161587.description: BackgroundMultidisciplinary tumour board (MTB) plays an important role in cancer care by collaborating specialist from various disciplines to discuss diagnosis, treatment plan and patient management. Despite its importance, a systematic evaluations of tumour board in hospital registered under hospital-based cancer registries (HBCRs) is limited.
